subject: info-dy
title: (R)INFO.DY.----C.CULT.AT.
description: Diagram in PR.S(RD)II-39. The prose above identifies the structural target: 'The controlling and defining forces of western information regulation function as a negative factor to the actual meta-reality of creative music.' The crossing diagrams how the reality of information-dynamics structurally meets composite culture attitude at the regulation-of-creative-music scale: (R)INFO-DY (reality of information dynamics) crossed with C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude). INFO-DY sits at lower-center with the subject-arrow; C-CULT-AT at upper-center as partner-axis. CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) upper-right, DOC (documentation) center-right, MD-DY (media dynamics) right, JR-DY (journalism dynamics) right. MT-INFO (multi-information) left. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) lower-left, AF-DY (affinity dynamics) lower-center, RT-DY (reality dynamics) lower-right, RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) lower-right. Structural argument: when reality-information-dynamics is crossed with composite-culture-attitude, the upper-right chain CULT-INFO-B -> MD-DY -> JR-DY -> DOC, branching from the main line, is the western-information-regulation route. Two further branches leave the main line lower down: T-C-IMP, whose line carries MT-INFO, and RT-DY, whose line carries AF-DY, with RT-INT-TR branching from AF-DY's line.
